name: com.bekaforge.dialogue-graph-system
description: Node-based dialogue authoring and runtime playback for Unity. Build branching conversations in a visual graph editor with full runtime support: portraits, audio, typewriter effect, choices, skip, autoplay, history, themes, actions, runtime variables, conditional flow, localization, and cross-graph traversal.

samples.description: Playable demo scene with sample dialogue graphs, characters, actions, and variables.
Sample characters (Dax, Maeve, Sol, Veya), actions (FadeLights, OpenGate, etc.), variables, themes, and environments.
